scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns only the algebraic central sharp contribution at a constant-curvature tensor and is not the spectrum of the full Ricci-flow linearization. The proof uses the primary source's exact normalization, central-channel formula, linearization identity, and irreducible Ricci decomposition. The three eigenvalues are obtained analytically from the action of the degree-zero derivations on a diagonal curvature-operator basis. A bundled checker reconstructs the derivation matrices and independently replays representative calculations in dimensions four through nine.
title: Complete space-form spectrum of the central sharp linearization
